name: app_task_checkpoint
description: Resolve this task/run report with concrete acceptance evidence or a specific blocker. Does not grant authorization.

name: app_reconcile_report
description: Needs no user approval card. Acknowledge an uncertain report as received, or retry only its delivery. Never replays the worker task.

name: app_handoff
description: Assign an authorized task to an app-managed agy or Codex worker; engine identity cannot change on resume. Returns task_id immediately. A correlated app_task_result arrives later. Does not grant tool permissions.

name: app_send_message
description: Continue an existing idle worker task using task_id. Busy workers reject steering; wait for their report. Does not authorize a new deliverable.

name: app_cancel_task
description: Stop one app-managed worker and its active tools.
